profile.headline: Senior C#/.NET Software Engineer | SQL Server | Financial Workflows, Integrations & Enterprise Applications. US Army Veteran
profile.summary:
Open to new opportunities in the Washington, DC metropolitan area.

Possesses a strong foundation in software engineering, OOP. Experienced in client/ server and multi-tiered architectures. Experienced in testing and debugging applications. Excellent problem solving and resolution skills. Effective communicator. 

Extensive database experience developing client/ server and multi-tiered applications and developing relational database management systems to include SQL Server, MySQL, and  Microsoft Access.

Experienced with .NET Framework to include C#, VB.NET, ASP.NET, ADO.NET, WCF, MVC, Entity Framework, and LINQ.

positions.title: IT Specialist - Full-stack .NET Software Engineer
positions.description: Member of a development team supporting IAMAW’s redevelopment initiative to replace outdated software systems. Works independently on projects to reverse engineer systems to gain insight into existing business rules and eliciting additional requirements. Redesigns back-end database management systems to ensure normalization of data. Designs multi-layered applications using Visual Studio 2017 – 2019, ASP.NET Web Form solutions, the .NET Framework 4.7+, C#, Entity Framework, Web API, Log4net, HTML(5), CSS(3), jQuery, JavaScript, Bootstrap, IIS, SQL Server 2012 – 2014, and GitHub. Ensures applications meet technical and functional requirements consistent with the current and planned infrastructure. Applies S.O.L.I.D. design principles and design patterns in support of the organizations mission to develop maintainable software solutions. Developing unit tests using xUnit testing framework and Moq to ensure components work as expected. Additionally, working with customers to ensure application designs and requested changes met requirements.

company.name: International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers

positions.title: .NET Software Engineer
positions.description: Member of a development team supporting GSA’s credentialing information management information system (GCIMS) eliciting requirements and designing/ maintaining .NET ASP.NET web form solutions using a combination of Visual Studio 2015, the .NET Framework, C#, VB.NET, GitHub, ADO.NET, MySQL, Fluent Validation, Log4net, HTML(5), CSS, JQuery, and BootStrap. Ensures applications meet technical and functional requirements consistent with the current and planned infrastructure. Develops unit tests for designed code using MS Test and xUnit testing framework. Participates in code reviews of submitted code changes to ensure code meets established coding standards and to ensure submitted code solves the intended problem or resolves bug. Works with testers to ensure application designs and changes meet requirements.

positions.title: IT Specialist Application Software
positions.description:
Member of a Scrum team analyzing, developing, testing, debugging, and maintaining software applications within an agency-wide information system. Ensures all applications meet technical and functional requirements and are consistent with the current and planned infrastructure. Develops object-oriented application solutions utilizing TFS, ReSharper, Ninject, C#, .NET, ASP.NET, MVC, WCF, XML, JSON, JavaScript, JQuery, SQL Server 2014, and T/ SQL programming languages to create database driven web and Windows / Windows Service applications.

Independently troubleshoots web and Windows applications and performs unit testing on developed software by exercising all logic paths. Assist in the development of test scripts and test cases. Participates in code reviews of submitted code changes to ensure application code meets standards and solves the intended problem. Mentors junior staff in .NET language and database design/ development.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst - C# Developer
positions.description:
Supported one of GEICO’s newest SOA systems targeted at customers and agents in a Microsoft development environment using Visual Studio 2015, C#, and TFS. Participated in daily scrum meetings, backlog grooming, estimations, and other Agile Scrum ceremonies to develop the requirements and to design, develop and implement the Application Program Interface (API) business functionality across multiple tiers using C# while adhering to coding standards. Tests developed business and integration functionality using XUnit, and the Moq Framework to ensure application development quality through peer and formal code review process.

Accomplishments:
Successfully passed GEICO’s level I and II training programs and examinations in C# with a 96% test average. Topics included the C# language syntax, OOP, extension methods, reflection, generics, lambda expressions, LINQ, design patterns, AutoMapper, unit testing, and Moq.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
Worked in collaboration with a team of peers to perform analysis with a primary focus on optimal resource management and allocation strategies through analysis of real property inventory management, manpower requirements, logistics programs, and authorizations.

Worked with key stakeholders to define problems/needs and develop methods to analyze and to determine optimal solutions.

Responsibilities included analytical data quality review, loading data into databases, producing tabular and graphic data summaries, identifying data issues and recommending solutions, defining data management strategies and helping develop data management workflows.

Identified problematic areas and conduct research to determine the best course of action to correct the data.

Identified, analyzed, and interpreted trends or patterns in complex data sets using Visual Basic Application (VBA) in association with MS Access and Excel.

Created automations running over multiple MS Office applications to export tables/queries and run MS Excel macros to repurpose and format data.

Mapped and traced data from system to system in order to solve a given business or system problem.

Summarized and synthesized complex analyses into simplified terms and present results to decision makers; Adept at queries and report writing.

Planned, evaluated, coordinated, and integrated actions with other staff elements and functions.

positions.title: Senior Microsoft Access Developer (Contract)
positions.description:
Worked in a client-facing environment and in collaboration with a team of peers to perform database development with a primary focus on upgrading and maintaining client/ server Microsoft Access Databases linked to Microsoft SharePoint lists and/ or Microsoft Access databases. Worked with key stakeholders to define problems/needs and develop methods to analyze and to determine optimal solutions.

Elicited requirements to update and enhance forms, reports, and SQL queries.

Identified problematic areas and conducted research to determine the best course of action to correct the database and or/ data.

Managed Microsoft Access 2013 databases simultaneously with varying levels of complexity. Designed and created dashboard forms and reports that summarized and graphed information from SharePoint 2013. 

Modified database structure to enforce referential integrity rules and eliminated redundant/ orphaned records to move databases towards third normal form. 

Documented existing database structures through the creation of ER diagrams using Microsoft Visio 2013 and data dictionaries.

Created automations running over multiple Microsoft Office applications to import data from Microsoft Excel spreadsheets.

Refactored VBA code to eliminate code duplication to optimize solutions.

positions.title: Independent Application/ Database Development Consultant
positions.description: Annually elicit requirements and update reports to reflect changes to a local transportation company's commuter bus schedules defined in Microsoft Access tables, forms, reports, Microsoft Excel templates. Continue to refactor VBA form code to reusable modules to eliminate duplication.

positions.title: I.T. Analyst/ Software Developer
positions.description: Analysis, design, implementation, testing, and maintenance in support of database and software applications. Ad-hoc reporting utilizing (SQL) Structured Query Language, SQL Server 2005, Microsoft Access XP - 2010, and Microsoft Excel. Developed client/ server applications using Microsoft Access 2003/ XP, VBA, SQL Server 2000/ 2005, stored procedures, and views.

positions.title: Software/ Database Developer
positions.description: Analysis, design, implementation, testing, and maintenance in support of database and software applications. Developed client/ server applications using Microsoft Access 2003/ XP, VBA, SQL Server 2000/ 2005, stored procedures, and views. Developed multi-tier .NET Windows Form applications using Visual Studio and VB.NET. Developed graphical annotation Windows Form application using VB.NET and Lead Tools Raster Imaging software. Developed reports using Microsoft Access 2003/ XP and Crystal Reports v10 - v11. Developed application using ESRI ArcInfo and VBA. Redesigned existing internal Microsoft Access databases to improve functionality, performance, and standardized application interfaces and reports.

positions.title: 88M - Motor Vehicle Transport Operator
positions.description:
Duties:
- Assistant Squad Leader
- Operated all wheel vehicles and equipment over varied terrain and roadways.
- Managed load, unload, and safety of personnel being transported.
- Oversaw and checked proper loading and unloading of cargo on vehicles and trailers.
- Employed convoy defense techniques.
- Identified, corrected or reported all vehicle deficiencies.
- Prepared vehicles for movement/shipment by air, rail or vessel.

Discharge:
- Honorable

projects.title: CMID Updater
projects.description:
Designed and developed a Windows Forms application using VB.NET and the .NET Framework 3.5.
	
Developed to assist users in selecting the correct version of the CMID client/ server database application. The application determined for the user the versions of Microsoft Windows, the version of Microsoft Access (XP, 2007, and / or 2010), and launched the correct version of the CMID client/ server database application. The application additionally facilitated updating the client installed on the user’s desktop based upon the major, minor, build, and release number of the client/ server application.

projects.title: CPJ Purchase Order Database
projects.description:
Developed client/ server database application developed using Microsoft Access 2003, VBA, and SQL Server 2000.

This application tracked all purchases made for each of CPJ's 4 office locations, by whom, and printed the corresponding PO to be sent to the applicable vendor.
